subject.title: feat: add disableBoundaryAwareCache compat option for prefix-matching prompt cache providers

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this public provider-scoped compatibility capability for DeepSeek, or instead apply the config-free suffix-relocation policy proposed by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94945?
rationale: Both branches address the same confirmed regression but establish different permanent provider and configuration contracts; code review cannot choose that product boundary safely without owner intent.

options.title: Adopt provider-scoped compatibility
options.body: Rebase this PR, retain the DeepSeek-only automatic default and explicit override, rerun proof, and close the competing strategy after landing.

options.title: Adopt config-free relocation
options.body: Require the sibling strategy to prove safe across affected OpenAI-compatible providers, then close this PR without adding a public compatibility key.

options.title: Pause both implementations
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open while owners gather additional provider/tool-call evidence and define a generic capability contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt provider-scoped compatibility
recommendation.body: Rebase this PR, retain the DeepSeek-only automatic default and explicit override, rerun proof, and close the competing strategy after landing.

likelyOwner.reason: The behavior appears to originate in this person's cache-boundary work, with additional recent ownership of the affected provider transport path.
